validation.execution: APFS reference and native scripts in deny-default sandbox; no home/credential/keychain/publishing access; read-only main-equivalent runtime build; loopback-only sockets explicitly bound to 127.0.0.1. Disposable archive source has no Git metadata. Main-equivalent signed module verified separately.
validation.scope: libc copyfile DATA|STAT|XATTR, fcopyfile DATA including unlinked source/destination and path reuse, direct Darwin sendfile partial-count accumulation/range/EOF/unchanged source offset, EXCL sentinel preservation, clone state and forced-clone capability.

limits: This change qualifies existing runtime behavior; it does not implement clone support or modify daemon/frontend runtime. No fresh full local CTest run is claimed. The new APFS reference is registered in macOS CTest; native mounting remains a separate acceptance.
COPYFILE_CLONE falls back to ordinary copy on forkfs with WAS_CLONED=false. CLONE_FORCE returns ENOTSUP; reference APFS actually clones. No forkfs CoW or zero-copy performance claim.
COPYFILE_EXCL preserved sentinel data, inode identity, mode, mtime and flags, but both filesystems updated ctime on failure. The compound library call is not a single atomic namespace mutation.
No ACL/ResourceFork/recursive-copy/full-flags, sparse allocation, headers/trailers, arbitrary load or multi-user qualification. Only the listed private single-user Darwin operations were measured.
